data.name: Freight Dogs
data.detailed_description:
Freight Dogs is a 3rd person casual, package delivery, exploration game which takes place during the "Animal Enlightenment Age". You take on the role of a wolf who has recently graduated from the Freight Dog training academy. You must now put your training to work by delivering packages, letters, envoy messages and more to earn your freight dog badge. 

Along the way, meet animal and human friends, discover beautiful landscapes, find lost letters, and choose your own adventure with hidden and branching stories.

Features:

  • Accept and deliver packages, letters, and messages between dogs, humans, and other animals

  • Figure out the mystery of a missing dog with the story-driven quests

  • Enjoy branching and choose your own adventure style quests to discover hidden stories

  • Explore a hand-crafted map with day and night cycle

  • Find lost packages and collectables

  • ...and more!

The world of Sarrow and the "Animal Enlightenment Age"

Freight Dogs takes place in the lore-heavy and story-rich world of "Sarrow" from the upcoming comic "Parade Dogs" by Streetfair and Kivak.

Without a reliable and abundant source of fossil fuel mankind chose a different path to progress through awakening animal minds. Using their unique strengths and weaknesses, animals are more than just pets and livestock - but the backbone of civilization. However, not all animals choose this life and the dangers of wild animals is real. 

Freight dogs have to be fast and reliable, delivering goods across the long distances of Sarrow. They must also be cunning and smart, evading dangerous wild animals, the elements of hard weather, and make the correct choices in difficult times.

data.short_description: Earn your badge as a Freight Dog in the Animal Enlightenment Age world of Sarrow. Trust is currency and you carry it in every letter, package, and secret whispered between man and beast. Explore at your own pace, forge your own path, and let every delivery tell its own story.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-6600K / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (6GB VRAM) / AMD Radeon RX 5600XT (6GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64bit
  • Processor: Intel i7-10700K / AMD Ryzen 7 5800
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 (16GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
